support.notes: Steam pin of the public branch head observed 2026-10-03 (manifest dated 2026-09-30): tool app 4019830, Linux depot 3501791, build 25630937, server ++dominion+hotfix-CL-247068. Superseded as the default by linux-25808123; kept so a server still on this build gets a matching plugin. The plugin resolves every engine address from this build's own `.sym` at load time, so the target needed no source change. `verification.required` stays `contract`: a hosted runner does not install the ~5.4 GB Steam depot, so the plugin's unit and native connector suites are what CI runs on every build; the runtime and gameplay proof above was recorded on the dev rig with a real client.

notes: One image builds and tests the plugin: node:*-bookworm (not slim) carries g++ on the same glibc as the dedicated server image, and Dockerfile.builder adds the four pinned static libraries on top of it. The server itself is a plain Steam depot install (no container images to load), so it installs through the shared Steam exact-install path like Conan Exiles.
